flags.why: This sense describes nasal mucus running or dangling from the nose, not drool ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=th%C3%B2+l%C3%B2)).
flags.fix: running from the nose in dangling strands (of nasal mucus)

flags.why: The example explains what Huế speakers call papaya instead of using the word in context.
flags.fix: Mạ mua một trái thù đủ chín. = Mum bought a ripe papaya.
